subtitle: A no-compromise gaming beast that destroys lag, heat, and frame drops before the match even begins 🔥🎮
whatMakesItSpecial: The ROG Phone 7 isn’t trying to look like a gaming phone — it IS one. Every part of this device is engineered for extreme mobile gaming, from the Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 chipset and advanced vapor cooling to AirTriggers, bypass charging, and esports-level FPS stability. It delivers console-grade performance in a pocket-sized form factor.

performance.cpu: Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 (4nm TSMC Architecture, up to 3.2GHz Prime Core)
performance.gpu: Adreno 740 GPU with advanced Vulkan optimization and hardware ray tracing support
performance.ram: 12GB / 16GB LPDDR5X RAM (ultra-fast multitasking and near-zero game reloads)
performance.storage: 256GB / 512GB UFS 4.0 Storage (extremely fast app loading and texture streaming)
performance.cooling: GameCool 7 Vapor Chamber + Boron Nitride Thermal Layers + Graphite Sheets
performance.realWorldImpact: Maintains stable FPS during long gaming sessions while avoiding aggressive thermal throttling common in most flagship phones.

benchmark.note: Raw benchmark numbers are powerful, but the real strength is sustained gaming performance under heavy load.

display.experience: Ultra-responsive touch response makes aiming, swiping, and competitive gameplay feel incredibly smooth and instant.

battery.gamingDrain: 8% – 12% battery drain per hour in competitive titles
battery.smartCharging: Supports Bypass Charging and Steady Charging to reduce heat and battery wear during marathon sessions

temperature.comfortLevel: Gets warm during demanding games but remains stable and comfortable compared to most gaming phones.

playability.Genshin Impact: High Settings with stable 60FPS exploration and combat
playability.Fortnite: Epic Quality Graphics with locked 60FPS gameplay
playability.Honkai Star Rail: Maximum Settings with smooth animations and combat effects
